svg.desc: In panel a, each configuration's replies over their round's SLO in version 1.24's 3 envelope rounds, each round a tick and the rounds pooled a marker, against the requirement of at most 5%, in panel b the agents' tokens a second over the calls' first 240 s and in panel c their time to first token at p99, each round a tick and their median a marker: the serving profile through v1.23 beside 4 agent sessions, 0, 2, 2 by round, 4 of 177 in all, its agents at 3,278 tokens a second (2,703 to 3,598) and a p99 of 8 s (6 to 8); the queue and the copy beside 12 agent sessions, 2, 2, 0 by round, 4 of 177 in all, its agents at 6,906 tokens a second (5,949 to 7,090) and a p99 of 24 s (19 to 73); and beside 24, 0, 3, 0 by round, 3 of 177 in all, its agents at 7,253 tokens a second (4,490 to 8,094) and a p99 of 133 s (132 to 182).
